# Public IPTV — public-iptv.online

> Short factual site summary for LLM/crawler consumers (experimental, low priority).

Public IPTV (https://public-iptv.online) offers premium IPTV subscriptions for
worldwide English-speaking viewers, starting with a free trial. Plans cover live
TV categories (sports, movies, news, kids, international), premium 4K/HD quality,
multi-device viewing via any compatible M3U playlist player, and human support.

- Home: https://public-iptv.online/
- Plans: https://public-iptv.online/#plans
- FAQ: https://public-iptv.online/#faq
- Contact: https://public-iptv.online/contact/
- Sitemap: https://public-iptv.online/sitemap.xml
